properties.name: Cauvery delta, Tamil Nadu
properties.why: India's 'rice bowl' (Thanjavur, Thiruvarur, Nagapattinam, Mayiladuthurai, Karaikal, Vedaranyam). The northeast monsoon usually starts in mid-October and brings the year's main rain and flood risk. Inside NISAR S-band track 084 A frame 007. The seaward edge follows the coast; open sea is excluded (low SNR, wind-driven).
